b: The Wood Industry Association (WIA) has announced its 2027 Board of Directors, following the successful completion of the Association’s annual election process. The newly elected and continuing board members will help guide WIA’s mission to support, connect, and advance the North American wood products industry.
Chair: Gordon Burdis, James L. Taylor Mfg. / JLT Clamps / Cameron Automation (2027-2028)
Chair-Elect: Brian Donahue, Safety Speed Manufacturing Company, Inc. (2027-2028)
Secretary/Treasurer: Adam Lopuk, Stiles Machinery, Inc. (2027-2028)
Jessica Freeseman, Wood Machinery Systems, Inc. (2025-2027)
